As financial institutions and the financial system evolve, stress testing will need to keep up.
When the next episode of financial instability presents itself, it may do so in a messy and unexpected way.
Banks will need to be ready not just for expected risks, but for unexpected ones.
Thus, the tests will need to vary from year to year, and to explore even quite unlikely scenarios.
